question: Which of the following screwdrivers has cross-shaped tips that are unlikely to slip from the cruciform slots in Philips recessed head screws?
solution:
The correct answer is __Cross-recess screwdriver****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cross-recess screwdriver__ is designed to fit precisely into cruciform slots.
 
• The tip is shaped like a cross, allowing for better grip and reducing the chance of slipping.
 
• This type of screwdriver is specifically suited for Philips recessed head screws.
 
• Its design ensures efficient torque transfer while minimizing damage to the screw head.
 
• Cross-recess screwdrivers are commonly used in assembly tasks across various industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Offset Screwdriver:**
 
 
• Designed for screws in tight spaces or awkward angles.
 
• Has a flat or angled tip but does not specialize in cross-shaped slots.
 
 
 
• **Stumpy Screwdriver:**
 
 
• Compact and short, ideal for tight spaces.
 
• Not specifically designed for Philips recessed head screws.
 
 
 
• **Ratchet Screwdriver:**
 
 
• Includes a ratchet mechanism for easier screwing and unscrewing.
 
• Can be adapted for various screwdriver tips but does not specialize in cross-recess slots.
